test_title: PYST 31: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was the impact of the Election Commission of India Network (ECINET) on the publication of Index Cards during elections?

options.text: Publication was delayed by several additional weeks.
Cards were handwritten by officials at local polling stations.
Cards were available within 72 hours of results.
Cards were discontinued as part of new digital reforms.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Cards were available within 72 hours of results**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Election Commission of India Network (ECINET)** is a specialized **Wide Area Network (WAN)** designed to facilitate seamless communication and data transfer between the **Election Commission of India (ECI)**, **Chief Electoral Officers (CEOs)** at the state level, and **District Election Officers (DEOs)**.
 
• Historically, the publication of **Index Cards**, which contain vital statistical data of each constituency, was a manual and time-consuming process that took several weeks or even months to complete after the declaration of results.
 
• The implementation of **ECINET** enabled the **electronic transmission** of election data from the counting centers directly to the central database, significantly reducing the turnaround time for data processing.
 
• As a result of this digital integration, the **Index Cards** became available for public and official use within **72 hours** of the announcement of election results. ***Hence, statement 3 is correct.***
